newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai gold imports dip in June - WGC.
newsitem.headline: Dubai gold imports dip in June - WGC.

text.p: Gold imports into Dubai fell to 46.13 tonnes in June from 52.29 the previous month, according to figures compiled by the Dubai customs department and released by the World Gold Council (WGC) on Monday.
Dubai traders attributed the decline to a traditional fall in key Indian demand because of the onset on the monsoon season.
Despite a fall-off in June imports, year-on-year comparisons showed robust growth in the emirate's appetite for gold.
Imports in June 1996 reached 28.39 tonnes while total imports for the first half of 1997 have hit 307.75 tonnes compared to 169.27 tonnes the same period last year.
"Demand from India (in India) has not shown such a heavy decline. In fact demand in the entire Gulf region is showing an uptrend," said D.V. Pathy, WGC's manager of Gulf states, said in a statement.
Leading suppliers to Dubai in June were Switzerland at 27.88 tonnes and the United Kingdom at 12.57 tonnes.
